newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING shares surge as 1996 profits restated.
newsitem.headline: ING shares surge as 1996 profits restated.

text.p: ING Groep NV shares were up almost six percent in afternoon trading, buoyed by new details of its profitability, brokers said on Wednesday.
The shares stood at 84.70 guilders at 1300 GMT, up 4.60 from Tuesday's close, after earlier touching a record high of 85.30.

The Dutch banking and insurance group on Tuesday issued a prospectus for its New York listing next month, showing that 1996 net profit was 1.35 billion guilders higher under U.S. GAAP, than Dutch, accounting methods at 4.67 million guilders.
"It gives (investors) a different view on the stock," said one equities dealer.
ING had to restate its accounts according to U.S. accounting standards ahead of its planned listing on the New York Stock Exchange on June 13.
The preliminary prospectus showed ING realised gains on the sale of shares and debt securities of 1.2 billion guilders in 1996, up from 476 million a year earlier.
Ton Gietman of HSBC Van Meer James Capel said ING had not revealed until now the size of the group's investment gains, which are not included in profits under Dutch standards.
"They were never willing to disclose these things," he said.
